problem: The ODA-created AC1024 empty named-block SORTENTSTABLE has zero reactors, while the original title fixture has one parent-dictionary reactor. The earlier source verifier refused the ODA profile.
implementation: Extend the source correlation only to accept either zero reactors or one reactor equal to the parent dictionary, with raw, publication and typed reactor count/vector equality and all previous frame, class, owner and empty-membership checks. No DWG parse body or export policy changes.
validation: The standard fast CTest retains the four physical one-reactor title controls and additionally reparses a bounded zero-reactor object body generated locally from a handwritten DXF through ODA 27.1; no DWG/DXF fixture file was added. It refuses mismatched reactor count/vector and a changed owner wire bit.

An optional second test argument reads the locally generated complete ODA AC1024 DWG, matches the zero-reactor source frame and runs 37 calibrated allocation failure/refusal/immediate-retry controls plus changed wire owner, membership owner and reactor negatives. The original title source still passes 164 allocation failure/retry controls.
Four focused sort/control/transaction CTests pass. Source-release inventory remains 1220 files and the 723-input qualification digest passes.
limits: The embedded generated object body is an encoder/decoder control and the optional ODA document is one independent producer witness. Neither proves general AC1024 named-block support, hidden references, graph closure, native AutoCAD/FreeCAD behavior or a support claim.
